properties.name: Italian Heritage Boulevard
properties.note: This used to be Christopher Columbus Boulevard, *and NJ TRANSIT, a state authority, not a city one*, still has it down as that. But the city changed the name in 2020, also removing the statue of Columbus that used to be at the base of the Expressway!
